say:1:1522018001:0.text: That's a shame! You only manage to reel in a regular fish.
say:1:1522018001:0.source_cn: 很遗憾，你钓上来的只是一条普通的鱼。

say:2:1522018002:1.text: From what those Wildborn just described, the Gilded Serpent isn't an easy catch. You're starting to think about dipping the bait in some divine elixir.
say:2:1522018002:1.source_cn: 听刚才那些人的描述，金鳞蛇皇恐怕不会轻易上钩。你甚至开...

say:3:1522018003:1.text: However, you ultimately brush off the idea, trusting yourself instead. After all, fishing is your domain.
say:3:1522018003:1.source_cn: 不过你依旧相信自己，毕竟你曾在沼泽边甩过无数次钓竿。钓...

say:4:1522018004:0.text: Just give it another go. Your experience tells you the next cast could bring a surprise.
say:4:1522018004:0.source_cn: 再试一下吧。以你的经验，下一竿总会有惊喜。

narration:5:1522018005:0.text: Once again, you cast the rod and wait patiently for a while...
narration:5:1522018005:0.source_cn: 你再次抛竿，耐心等待了一会儿……

narration:6:1522018006:0.text: As something bites, you feel a strong pull on the line.
narration:6:1522018006:0.source_cn: 当鱼再次咬钩时，你感受到了强大的拉力

narration:8:1522018007:0.text: After an intense tug-of-war, you haul a crocodile out of the water!
narration:8:1522018007:0.source_cn: 一番巧劲搏斗之后，一只鳄鱼被你从水里拖了出来！

narration:14:15023333:0.text: The sudden appearance of a crocodile startles both you and Gala.
narration:14:15023333:0.source_cn: 突然出现的鳄鱼让你和加拉大惊失色。
narration:14:15023333:0.male: The sudden appearance of a crocodile startles both you and Gala.
narration:14:15023333:0.female: The sudden appearance of a crocodile startles both you and Gala.
